ulike-air-10.text: An at-home IPL hair removal device that is FDA-cleared, close to painless and gentle on sensitive skin. Ulike reports 96% hair reduction in two weeks, and a full-body session takes about 10 minutes.

ultra-violette-preen-screen-spf-50.text: An ultra-fine SPF 50 mist for reapplying sunscreen over makeup. A few sprays refresh your face, help set makeup, and leave an invisible, semi-glowy finish. The new airless pump gives a continuous mist.

unite-hair-7seconds-anti-frizz-thermo-mi.text: A lightweight, heat-activated leave-in mist that shields each strand, locks in moisture and blocks humidity for smooth, shiny, frizz-free hair that lasts up to 72 hours. Works on all hair types, including curly and frizz-prone.

victoria-beckham-beauty-colour-wash.text: A sheer, watercolour-style liquid tint that soaks into the skin for a flush that looks like it comes from within. It sets slowly, so there's time to blend with fingers or a brush, then lasts all day.

star.name: Coconut water
star.does: Gives the formula its light, watery texture

victoria-beckham-beauty-eye-wardrobe.text: Victoria Beckham's eyeshadow palette of balanced four-shade colour sets, with buttery, blendable powders in a range of luxurious finishes. The colours build easily and feel silky on the lid.

victoria-beckham-beauty-satin-kajal-line.text: A creamy, waterproof kajal pencil that glides on in one swipe and doesn't smudge. Wear it crisp or smoked out; the shades are sophisticated neutrals and vivid colours.

star.name: Chamomile extract
star.does: Helps keep the eye area comfortable

voesh-gua-sha-massage-body-cleansing-bar.text: A body cleansing bar shaped like a gua sha tool, so washing doubles as a lymphatic-style massage that helps reduce puffiness, sculpt and support circulation. It fits comfortably in the palm and leaves skin fresh and balanced.

voesh-hand-balm.text: A rich, velvety hand balm that absorbs in seconds to hydrate, nourish and protect hands and cuticles without feeling greasy. Lightly scented. NewBeauty Award winner, 2026.

vyrao-witchy-woo-cream-scent.text: A solid-style cream perfume of Vyrao's Witchy Woo, massaged into the hands or neck. The scent runs from ambrette and pink pepper through orris and rose to patchouli, labdanum and white musk.

star.name: Mango seed butter
star.does: Gives the cream its soft, nourishing base

wavytalk-multi-curl.text: A 5-in-1 curling set with clip-in ceramic barrels: a 0.5" micro wand, a tapered 0.5–1" barrel, a 1" bubble barrel, a 1.25" wand and a 1.5" thermal brush, covering everything from tight spirals to loose waves. It heats up in 30 seconds and has two temperature settings.

westmore-beauty-lasting-effects-soft-gli.text: A highly pigmented gel eyeliner that glides on without tugging or skipping for smooth, precise lines or a smoky blended look. Once set it's waterproof and smudge-proof.

winky-lux-uni-brow-polishing-wax.text: A universal-shade brow wax pencil that fills sparse areas with soft hold, paired with a flexible silicone brush to blend and tame, for natural shape and definition.

star.name: Vitamin E and sunflower seed oil

wonderskin-phlush-stick.text: A multi-use stick for cheeks, lips and lids with pH-reactive pigment that adjusts to your skin to give your own rosy shade, so it works on all skin tones. It feels cool and refreshing on the skin.

xomd-skincare-arouse-moisturizer.text: A lightweight but nourishing barrier-support moisturiser, the last step of XOMD's routine. It hydrates, adds luminosity and leaves skin smooth and supple. It suits all skin types, including sensitive, post-treatment and peri- to post-menopausal skin.
